Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: fire
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: The element of fire. What the ritual or spell does, it does as fire: burning, heat, ash. Pure, it is fire as it is; in Avir hands, distorted, it mends what it touches.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: water
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: The element of water, with cold and ice as its own branch (cryomancy). What is done, is done as water: wetting, pressing, cooling, quenching.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: earth
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: The element of earth: stone, soil, weight. What is done, is done as earth: binding, shielding, shaping the ground. With water, it mixes without distortion.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: air
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: The element of air: wind, breath, pressure. What is done, is done as air: pushing, carrying, choking, lifting.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: light
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: The element of light: radiance, purity, sight. What is done, is done as light: burning the wrong, revealing, blinding. With darkness - infinity.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: time
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: The element of time: ageing, slowing, foresight - the school of prediction and reckoning. With darkness - timelessness, where time runs wrong.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: life
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: The element of life: moving the energy of one living thing into another - drained grass to mend a wound, a drained foe to a skeleton. Blood is its branch. With darkness - necromancy.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: darkness
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: The mark of the Labyrinthian, its pure energy: the touch on every living mind - illusion. Woven with another element, it distorts it; what comes of it depends on what it is woven with.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: space
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Space, the minor school of telekinesis: the room between the caster and the thing - its mass, its distance, the threads that catch it. It comes easily to those who fly.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: aura
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: A form: a field round the caster, lasting while it is held. Its element decides what it does to those inside. (Its effect is not made yet.)

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: enchanting
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: A form: the element laid onto a weapon, a body or an ally for a while. (Its effect is not made yet.)

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: step
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: A form: moving - the caster, or another - through or by the element. (Its effect is not made yet.)

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: restoring
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: A form: returning a thing or a body towards how it was - mending, cleansing, undoing. (Its effect is not made yet.)

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: beam
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: A form: a lasting channel from the caster to a line or a target, while the caster holds it. Hard, and strong. (Its effect is not made yet.)

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: shaping
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: A form: changing the ground or things - melting, raising, freezing, ageing. Hard, and far-reaching. (Its effect is not made yet.)

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: summoning
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: A form: calling forth a creature or a thing of the element. Hard. (Its effect is not made yet.)

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: sensing
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: A form: seeing, finding, foreseeing - through the element. Hard, and quiet. (Its effect is not made yet.)
